_comment: EXP-000 is the offline framework self-check. It has no hardware and no raw logs; it exists to prove that analyze_experiment.py computes correct metrics on a fixture whose answers are known in advance, and that it REFUSES to report a metric whose denominator has no ground truth. The decision file under results/ is authored by hand BECAUSE this is a fixture: every expected number is derived by counting, not by running the system.
title: framework self-check on a fixture with known answers

hardware.note: offline fixture: no hardware is used, no device is contacted

sampling.note: window length of the fixture, not a device sampling interval

pairing_config.note: not applicable to a fixture; max_sample_age is set from EXP-004 on hardware

dataset_reuse.note: the fixture is self-contained and shares nothing with any hardware experiment

n.basis: fixture size chosen so every expected metric can be verified by counting by hand

statistics.note: this is a correctness check of the analysis code, not a measurement, so no test is declared

expected_event: 20 decision windows: 5 over sensor faults, 5 over shared events, 10 over quiet periods

expected_metrics._comment: Hand-derived by counting the fixture. These are the numbers tests assert.
